notes: Carbon molecular sieve membrane (PVDF-HFP/PVP-derived, alumina-supported) paper on H2/CH4 separation. The only H2 measurements are single-gas permeation: the permeability coefficient is defined as 'P = Q/(A·Δp)' (main, p. 4, Section 2.3, Eq. 1), Table 3 gives 'Permeability of various gases at different temperatures' (main, p. 10) and Figure 10 plots 'H2 Flow rate (ml·min-1)' against ΔP (main, p. 11). A permeate flux through a membrane is not an amount of H2 taken up by a sorbent, so I1 is not met; the work is experimental and not electrochemical, so the code is no_conditions_stated. Table 4 'Adsorption binding force/atm' values are listed constants per gas, not a measured uptake. For information only (not assessed): characterization is FTIR, TGA and SEM only (Section 2.4), and no specific surface area appears anywhere. Not a review/thesis/abstract-only (original data), is_retracted false and no retraction notice, and no statement that the data were published before. Page numbers are the printed ones; page images are offset by one because main-01.png is the publisher's download cover.
